name: Changdeokgung Palace Complex
description: Changdeokgung is a royal palace in Seoul, founded in 1405 and rebuilt after the Japanese invasion of 1592 destroyed it. For centuries it served as the Joseon kings' main residence, and it remains one of Korea's best-preserved palaces. Its halls follow the natural slopes of the land, and the wooded Secret Garden behind them is the highlight, open mainly by guided tour.
